reply_text:
Gist: Agreed, no timer. I'll trigger the catch-up on turns instead. Whenever a turn starts or ends in a seat, including resumes and bells, that seat's recent analysed-but-unprocessed readings get processed. In a live buffer that happens within a turn or two, without anything ticking in the background. codex-5 is already partway through the timer version. When it lands I'll swap the timer for the turn trigger myself and keep its bounded selection and tests. That's quicker than re-sending the packet.

The reaper's existing checks after an analysis is dispatched stay as they are. Those are also time-based: three checks, 180 s apart. But they belong to a dispatch rather than running as a background loop. If you'd rather they became turn-triggered too, say so and I'll fold them into the same change.

Recorded as a decision in the mission file at 83adffc3, so it survives if my context is compacted before the wake.
